items.source:
#VIOLET#*Kyless lies dying on the floor. In his hand he holds a book.*#LAST#
Please! Before I die I have one request. Destroy the book. It wasn't me. The book brought this on us. It must be destoyed!
items.target:
#VIOLET#*克里斯躺在地板上奄奄一息。他的手里还握着一本书。*#LAST#
求求你！在我死前我有一个请求！毁掉这本书。其实不是我，是这本书将灾难带给了我们。它必须被毁掉！

items.source: I will. #LIGHT_GREEN#[destroy the book]#LAST#
items.target: 好的。 #LIGHT_GREEN#[毁掉那本书]#LAST#

items.source: I'm sorry but I need it. #LIGHT_GREEN#[keep the book]#LAST#
items.target: 对不起我需要它。#LIGHT_GREEN#[拿走这本书]#LAST#

items.source: #VIOLET#*You destroy the book. When you finish you look up and see that Kyless is already dead.*#LAST#
items.target: #VIOLET#*你毁掉了这本书。当你做完这一切后，你发现克里斯已经死了。*#LAST#

items.source: Goodbye, Kyless.
items.target: 再见，克里斯。

items.source: #VIOLET#*You place the book in your pack. When you finish you look up and see that Kyless is already dead.*#LAST#
items.target: #VIOLET#*你将这本书放到了背包里。当你做完这一切后，你发现克里斯已经死了。*#LAST#

items.source: Welcome, @playername@, to Last Hope. Traveler, please be quick as my time is precious.
items.target: 欢迎你，@playername@，欢迎来到最后的希望。旅行者，你最好抓紧时间，我的时间很宝贵。

items.source: I have found a strange staff in my travels (#LIGHT_GREEN#*describe it in detail*#LAST#)  It looked very old and very powerful. I dared not use it.
items.target: 我在旅途中找到了一根法杖。(#LIGHT_GREEN#*详细说明事情的来龙去脉*#LAST#) 它看上去很古老但拥有强大的力量。我不敢使用它。

items.source: The hunt for the staff took me to a continent far to the east, accessible only by magic portal. I've recently returned by just such a portal, and I come bearing instructions on how to construct a similar portal here in Last Hope to make the return journey possible. I'm sure the Elves there would welcome trade with the west.
items.target: 追踪这根法杖的时候我到达了远东的一个大陆，只有通过魔法传送门才能到达那儿。刚才我就用这样的一个传送门返回这里，我现在就是来告诉大家如何制造一个类似的传送门从最后的希望通往远东大陆，我相信那里的精灵会很乐意同我们进行贸易往来。

items.source: Nothing, excuse me. Bye!
items.target: 没事，抱歉打扰了，再见！

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He remains silent for a while*#WHITE# Indeed you were right to come here.
The staff you describe reminds me of an artifact of great power from ancient times. May I see it?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他沉默了一段时间*#WHITE# 的确你来这里是对的。
你描述的法杖让我想起了一件在古代有强大力量的神器，能让我看一下么？

items.source: Here it is. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell him about the encounter with the orcs*#LAST# You should keep it. I can feel its power and it would be safer if it were guarded by the armies of the kingdom.
items.target: 就是这个。 #LIGHT_GREEN#*告诉他有关被兽人部队伏击的事。*#LAST# 你应该拿着它。我能感受到它的力量，法杖在王国军队的保护下才是安全的。

items.source: I am afraid I lost it. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell him about the encounter with the orcs*
items.target: 恐怕我把它弄丢了。 #LIGHT_GREEN#*告诉他有关被兽人部队伏击的事。*

items.source: I had it briefly but have lost it somehow.  It could have been some orcs I encountered ...
items.target: 我本来有它，但不知怎么弄丢了。大概是被我遇到的兽人抢走了……

items.source:
I am truly astonished by your strength; surviving that encounter was an epic feat.
As for the orcs, it is deeply troubling.  We have not seen any for eighty years... could they have come from the far east?
Anyway, thank you again, @playername@, for your help.
items.target:
我很惊讶你的力量，能在袭击中活下来可是一项壮举。
关于兽人，这就有点麻烦了。我们已经80年没有见过他们了……难道他们是从远东大陆过来的？
不管怎样，还是非常感谢，@playername@, 感谢你的帮助。

items.source: Thank you, my lord.
items.target: 谢谢你，阁下。

items.source:
Orcs?! In the west?! This is deeply alarming! We have not seen any for nearly eighty years. They must have come from the far east...
But do not let me trouble you; you brought important news and you are lucky to be alive.
items.target:
兽人？在西部大陆？！这非常令人担忧！我们几乎已经80年没有见到过兽人了，他们肯定是从远东大陆来的……
不过别让我耽误你了，你带来了重要的消息，而且你还能活下来已经很幸运了。

items.source:
We have heard rumours from the Dwarves that there may still be an orc presence deep in the old kingdom of Reknor, in the Iron Throne.
I know you have been through a lot, but we need somebody to investigate and determine if there is a connection with the staff.
items.target:
有来自矮人的传说，在钢铁王座古王国瑞库纳深处可能仍有兽人的踪迹。
我知道你已经经历了很多事，不过我们还是需要一个人去调查一下，确认他们与法杖之间的联系。

items.source: I will check the mines.
items.target: 我会去矿坑那里调查。

items.source: That's extraordinary! I know a number of merchant princes who will salivate at the idea of new trade routes opening. But tell me, how fares your quest for the staff?
items.target: 真不可思议！对于新商路的开辟，我知道一些富商知道这个消息后肯定会高兴的直流口水。不过你还没告诉我，关于法杖的事情，进行的怎么样了？

items.source: The staff is recovered and the culprits slain. They will trouble us no more. [tell him the whole story]
items.target: 法杖已经找回，罪犯已经被处决，他们不会再困扰我们了。[告诉他整个事情经过。]

items.source: The hunt continues. The construction of this portal will be of great assistance in the staff's recovery.
items.target: 追查仍在继续。建造这座传送门将极大地帮助我们找回法杖。

items.source: Excellent! Well then, concerning this fascinating portal, I'm afraid that men have largely forgotten whatever they once knew about the great magics of old. I know of only one man in these lands who might be able to help you, a wise man and recent arrival to Last Hope named Tannen. He claims to hail from Angolwen, a supposed haven for practitioners of magic and mysticism. He arrived just months ago with fabulous wealth and has already constructed his own tower in the northern part of the city. I know little of him, but if he is to be believed, then he is your best hope.
items.target: 太棒了！但是，关于这个有趣的传送门，恐怕很多人早已将古老魔法遗忘了。我只知道在这个大陆上有一个人可能能够帮助你，一个最近才来到最后希望的智者。他的名字叫泰恩，他自称他是从安格利文来的，那是传说中的神秘魔法港湾，他几个月前刚带着巨额财富来到这里，他在城市北部边境建造了他的塔楼。我对他了解不多，不过如果他是个可信之人的话，应该是最有可能帮上你的。

items.source: Thank you.
items.target: 谢谢。

items.source: In that case, let us proceed as quickly as possible. Now, concerning this fascinating portal. I'm afraid that men have largely forgotten whatever they once knew about the great magics of old. I know of only one man in these lands who might be able to help you, a wise man and recent arrival to Last Hope named Tannen. He claims to hail from Angolwen, a supposed haven for practitioners of magic and mysticism. He arrived just months ago with fabulous wealth and has already constructed his own tower in the northern part of the city. I know little of him, but if he is to be believed, then he is your best hope.
items.target: 那样的话，我们就长话短说，关于这个有趣的传送门，恐怕很多人早已将古老魔法遗忘了。我只知道在这个大陆上有一个人可能能够帮助你，一个最近才来到最后希望的智者。他的名字叫泰恩，他自称他是从安格利文来的，那是传说中的神秘魔法港湾，他几个月前刚带着巨额财富来到这里，他在城市北部边境建造了他的塔楼。我对他了解不多，不过如果他是个可信之人的话，应该是最有可能帮上你的。

items.source: Urthol's Wondrous Emporium
items.target: 乌瑟尔商场

items.source:
Ah, my #{italic}#good#{normal}# friend @playername@!
Thanks to you I made it safely to this great city! I am planning to open my most excellent boutique soon, but since I am in your debt, perhaps I could open early for you if you are in need of rare goods.
items.target:
啊, 我 #{italic}#亲爱的#{normal}# 朋友 @playername@!
多亏了你我安全回到了这个伟大的城市！ 我的精品商店过些日子正打算开张营业。不过既然我欠你个人情，要是你需要一些稀有物品的话也许我可以为你提前开张。

items.source: By the way,
items.target: 顺带一提，

items.source: during our escape I found the plans for an #YELLOW#Ambush Trap#LAST#
items.target: 在逃亡过程中我找到了个好点子—— #YELLOW#伏击陷阱#LAST#

items.source: and while
items.target: ，同时在

items.source: while
items.target: 在

items.source: organizing my inventory, I came across some #YELLOW#Smelly Toxin#LAST# that a colleague claimed could actually turn creatures to stone.  Truly exotic!
items.target: 我整理货物时, 我发现了一些 #YELLOW#石化毒剂#LAST# ，据说能把生物变成石头。 真的很棒！

items.source: You would not happen to be interested, by any chance?
items.target: 你应该会对它感兴趣吧？

items.source: Oh my friend, good news! As I told you I can now request a truly #{italic}#unique#{normal}# object to be crafted just for you. For a truly unique price...
items.target: 噢我的好朋友，我告诉过你我可以为你打造一件真正#{italic}#独一无二#{normal}#的物品，专门为你量身定做哦，而且价格也同样独一无二……

items.source: I eventually plan to arrange a truly unique service for the most discerning of customers. If you come back later when I'm fully set up I shall be able to order for you something quite marvellous. For a perfectly #{italic}#suitable#{normal}# price, of course.
items.target: 我准备为最有眼光的那位顾客提供一件真正独特的服务。如果你过会儿回来，我将做好充分准备后给你一个大大的惊喜。而且价格绝对#{italic}#公道#{normal}#哦！当然！

items.source: Yes please, let me see your wares.
items.target: 好吧，让我看看你的货物。

items.source: What about the unique object?
items.target: 不如说说那个特殊物品？

items.source: Ambush Trap?  Sounds useful.
items.target: 伏击陷阱？听上去很不错

items.source: Smelly Toxin?  What kind of smell?
items.target: 臭毒素？什么样的气味？

items.source: Sorry, I have to go!
items.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

items.source:
You know, I have asked here and there and it happens to be a very rare thing this contraption...
But since you have saved me, I'm willing to part from it for only 3000 gold pieces, a real bargain!
items.target:
你要知道，我问遍了每个地方都没发现有相同的东西。
不过，既然你救了我的命，给我3000金币我就把它转让给你。这可是很划算的！

items.source: Expensive, but I will take it.
items.target: 虽然很贵，不过我要了。

items.source: Nice doing business with you my friend. There you go!
items.target: 和你做生意真愉快！

items.source: Thanks.
items.target: 多谢。

items.source:
Ungrol told me this substance contains some exceedingly rare components.
"More Toxin than Medicine" he said.  Allas, he had not the funds to buy it.  On the other hand, because of our special relationship, I'm willing to let you have it #{italic}#at cost#{normal}# -- only 1500 gold pieces!
items.target:
温格勒发现这种物质含有某些稀有成分，
“与其说是药，不如说是毒。”他说，但他没钱买下来。 基于我们的良好关系，我很愿意按成本价卖给你——#{italic}#只要#{normal}# 1500 金币！

items.source: Fairly pricey, but seems useful.  We have a deal!
items.target: 有点贵，不过应该能派上用场。我要了！

items.source: That price ... er stuff really stinks ...
items.target: 这价格……呃，真够臭的……

items.source: Here you are.  Just be sure not to get any on yourself!
items.target: 给你了。别洒在自己身上了

items.source: I normally offer this service only for a truly deserved price, but for you my friend I am willing to offer a 20% discount - #{italic}#only#{normal}# 4000 gold to make an utterly unique item of your choice.  What do you say?
items.target: 对于这项服务，只有到了合理的价位我才会愿意提供给别人，不过对你，我的朋友，我准备给你打个20%的折扣—— #{italic}#只要#{normal}# 4000 金币就可以打造一个真真正正你特有的装备哦，怎么样？

items.source: Why, 'tis a paltry sum - take my order, man, and be quick about it!
items.target: 什么？这点小钱无所谓，赶紧给我弄出来吧！

items.source: Yes, please!
items.target: 好的，请吧。

items.source: HOW MUCH?! Please, excuse me, I- I need some fresh air...
items.target: 多少钱？！呃……抱歉，我……我得出去呼吸一下新鲜空气……

items.source: Not now, thank you.
items.target: 现在不用，再见。

items.source: dragonbone wand
items.target: 龙骨魔杖

items.source: dragonbone totem
items.target: 龙骨图腾

items.source: voratun torque
items.target: 沃瑞钽项圈

items.source: I've changed my mind.
items.target: 我决定不买了。

items.source: Which kind of item would you like ?
items.target: 你喜欢什么类型的装备？

items.source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
items.target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

items.source:
Do you want to name your item?
%s
items.target:
你想要命名你的物品吗？
%s

items.source: Yes, please.
items.target: 是的。

items.source: Name your item
items.target: 给你的装备起名

items.source: Name
items.target: 名称

items.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#The merchant carefully hands you: %s
items.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#商人小心的交给了你：%s

items.source: No thanks.
items.target: 不用了，谢谢。

items.source: Oh I am sorry, it seems we could not make the item your require.
items.target: 啊真抱歉，这东西我们可做不了。

items.source: Oh, let's try something else then.
items.target: 好吧，我们试试别的东西。

items.source: Oh well, maybe later then.
items.target: 好吧，以后再说。

items.source: *This store does not appear to be open yet*
items.target: *这个商店好像还没开张。*

items.source: [leave]
items.target: [离开]
